name: fg_b_siege
notes: Faster games, experiment B (docs/balance/faster_games_2026-10-06.md): one siege unit per kingdom. Fire Ash Hurler (T1, x2.0 vs buildings), Ice Frost Mortar (T2, x2.6 on top of its own Frost Shell x1.5), two NEW T2 units (lab data in tools/balance_lab/faster_games/units/): Shadow Grave Mangonel and Nature Stoneroot Hurler (x3.5). Siege units shoot buildings in range first; bots keep ~15 % of soldier pop as siege from Stronghold. Needs tools/balance_lab/faster_games/fg_match.gd (the 'fg' block); the plain Balance Lab ignores it.
